# Suitedash

All-in-one business software for client management, CRM, project management, and invoicing

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/suitedash/.

## Actions

- **Create Company**: Create a new company in SuiteDash CRM.
- **Create Contact**: Create a new contact in SuiteDash CRM.
- **Get Company** (read-only): Retrieve a single company by UID or Name from SuiteDash.
- **Get Contact by UID or Email** (read-only): Retrieve a single contact from SuiteDash by their UID or email address.
- **List Companies** (read-only): Retrieve all existing companies from SuiteDash.
- **List Contacts** (read-only): Get all existing contacts from SuiteDash.
- **Get Company Meta Attributes** (read-only): Retrieve CRM company meta attributes information.
- **Get Contact Meta Attributes** (read-only): Retrieve CRM contact meta attributes information.
